ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-orange soft scrambled-looking mass with fine crumbly curds, slightly glossy, spread across the upper center of the plate about 9 cm wide and 2 cm tall at the thickest | 150
ITEM 2 | Bright green broccoli florets, several small clusters with dark char spots on the tips, firm stems, covering about 6 cm across on the left side of the plate, roughly 2 cm tall | 70
ITEM 3 | Orange-fleshed melon cubes with slightly rounded edges and a smooth, moist surface, about 2 to 3 cm per cube, piled in a cluster on the right-lower side of the plate about 8 cm by 6 cm, roughly 2.5 cm tall | 140
ITEM 4 | Golden-brown roasted potato chunks with crisp, browned, slightly charred outer edges and pale interior, about 2 to 2.5 cm pieces, arranged in a loose row on the left edge of the plate, about 1.5 cm tall | 80
ITEM 5 | Dark brown mushroom pieces with glossy, slightly wrinkled caps, one visible near the top of the scrambled mass, about 2 cm across, sitting on and beside the eggs | 15
